goal: The admin keeps its session fresh with Supabase's auth client alone, so an idle admin screen loads none of Supabase's realtime, storage or database client; uploads still load the full client on the press.
why: After step 0.9 the whole Supabase client (259 KB) still loads on every admin screen once it is idle, leaving an idle store home near 930,000 bytes of script (1,428,740 at the review); the auth client alone is about 117 KB, which brings the idle home to 800,000 or less.

depends_on.why: it changes src/components/admin/session.tsx to load the Supabase client with import() once the page is idle; this step swaps what that import() loads
its by-idle case in e2e/signed-in/admin-scripts.spec.ts is the measure

commits.title: The admin's session keeper loads Supabase's auth client alone

changes.how: Add "@supabase/auth-js": "2.118.0" to dependencies, the exact version already installed under @supabase/supabase-js (check: ls node_modules/.pnpm | rg 'supabase\+auth-js' prints @supabase+auth-js@2.118.0; if the installed version differs, use the installed one, pinned exactly like the other Supabase lines). Run pnpm install and commit pnpm-lock.yaml: the lockfile must gain only the importer line, no new package.

Export createAuthClient(), a per-tab singleton (keep it in a module variable) that builds the same auth client @supabase/ssr's createBrowserClient builds, without the rest of supabase-js. Read node_modules/@supabase/ssr/dist/main/createBrowserClient.js lines 25 to 60 and node_modules/@supabase/supabase-js/dist/index.cjs (_initSupabaseAuthClient) and copy their arguments exactly: import { AuthClient } from '@supabase/auth-js'; import { createStorageFromOptions } from '@supabase/ssr/dist/module/cookies' (the package has no exports map, so the path resolves; if the type check cannot find its types, add a one-line declaration for that path in src/types beside the repo's other declarations); const env = publicEnv() from '@/lib/env'; const { storage } = createStorageFromOptions({ cookieEncoding: 'base64url' }, false); const base = new URL(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL); return new AuthClient({ url: new URL('auth/v1', base.href.endsWith('/') ? base.href : base.href + '/').href, headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + key, apikey: key, 'X-Client-Info': 'supabase-ssr/0.12.7 createBrowserClient' }, storageKey: 'sb-' + base.hostname.split('.')[0] + '-auth-token', flowType: 'pkce', autoRefreshToken: true, detectSessionInUrl: true, persistSession: true, storage }) where key is env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY. The storage key and the cookie encoding must be the same as the server's client (src/lib/supabase/server.ts uses createServerClient with the same URL, so the default key is the same formula): the server must read the cookies this client writes. Comment: why the auth client alone (259 KB against about 117 KB), and that the values mirror @supabase/ssr 0.12.7, to be re-read on an upgrade.

A vitest test (jsdom or a stubbed document.cookie, as other browser-side tests in src/lib do; rg -l 'document.cookie' src -g '*.test.ts' shows one to copy). (1) With NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL='https://abcd.supabase.co' the client's storage key is 'sb-abcd-auth-token', equal to the key of createBrowserClient(url, key) from @supabase/ssr built in the same test (read both through the private field the library keeps, or by writing a session with one and reading it with the other). (2) A session written by createBrowserClient's auth.setSession-equivalent storage write is returned by createAuthClient().getSession(), and the reverse. (3) The test reads node_modules/@supabase/ssr/package.json and fails with the message 're-read createBrowserClient.js and update auth-client.ts' when its version is not 0.12.7.

Replace the use of createClient from '@/lib/supabase/client' by createAuthClient from '@/lib/supabase/auth-client', keeping the way step 0.9 loads it (an import() once the page is idle: the import() now names '@/lib/supabase/auth-client'). SessionKeeper: client.onAuthStateChange(() => {}) on the auth client itself (it was createClient().auth.onAuthStateChange) and unsubscribe on unmount, still skipped when cookiesReadable(document) is false. SessionRecovery: client.getSession() on the auth client (it was client.auth.getSession()); every branch after it stays as it is. The file must no longer import '@/lib/supabase/client' in any form.
Keep createClient() as it is. Add to its comment: the full client is for uploads and imports only and must be loaded on the press with import(); the session is kept by auth-client.ts.
